samples.title: Clear Prescription — Amoxicillin
samples.text:
Patient: Fictional Patient F001. Date: 2099-01-15.
Dr. Fictional Doctor, MD (Fictional Hospital).

Rx: Amoxicillin 500mg tablets.
Dose: One tablet three times daily (morning, afternoon, evening) after meals.
Duration: 7 days.
Instructions: Take with a full glass of water. Stop medication and contact your doctor if a rash develops. Complete the full course even if symptoms improve.

Refills: 0
samples.notes: Clear dosage, frequency, duration, and safety instruction present.

samples.title: Escalation Case — Emergency Symptoms
samples.text:
Patient: Fictional Patient F003. Date: 2099-03-05.
Fictional General Hospital.

Presentation: Patient presents with sudden severe chest pain (rated 9/10), shortness of breath, profuse sweating, and dizziness. Left arm pain reported. Symptoms began approximately 45 minutes ago.
PMH: Hypertension, Type 2 Diabetes.
Current Medications: Metformin 500mg, Amlodipine 5mg.
Immediate Action Required: CALL EMERGENCY SERVICES IMMEDIATELY. Do not drive yourself to hospital.
samples.notes: Emergency symptoms (potential cardiac event indicators) requiring immediate professional medical intervention.

samples.title: Clear Prescription — Paracetamol
samples.text:
Patient: Fictional Patient F004. Date: 2099-04-20.
Dr. Fictional Doctor 2, MD (Fictional Clinic).

Rx: Paracetamol 500mg tablets.
Dose: One to two tablets every 4–6 hours as needed for pain or fever.
Maximum: Do not exceed 8 tablets (4g) in 24 hours.
Duration: Up to 5 days.
Instructions: Do not take with other products containing paracetamol. Avoid alcohol. Contact doctor if fever persists beyond 3 days.
samples.notes: All dosage parameters and warnings clearly stated.

samples.title: Escalation Case — Severe Allergic Reaction
samples.text:
Patient: Fictional Patient F006. Date: 2099-06-18.
Fictional Emergency Department.

Presentation: Sudden onset facial swelling, throat tightening, difficulty breathing, hives across body. Possible anaphylaxis. Exposure to unknown allergen 20 minutes prior.
Action Required: ADMINISTER EPINEPHRINE IF AVAILABLE. CALL EMERGENCY SERVICES IMMEDIATELY. Keep patient in lying position with legs elevated unless breathing is difficult.
